faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you remove in Kew Gardens, Queens?
faqs.answer: We treat wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, ground bee, and bumble bee nests throughout Kew Gardens. Our technicians identify the species, locate the nest entrance, and customize treatment strategies for each — paper wasp and bald-faced hornet nests in eaves and soffits, yellow jacket colonies in wall voids and attics, carpenter bee galleries in structural wood, and ground-nesting yellow jackets and bees in lawn burrows. Honeybee colonies are referred to a licensed beekeeper.
